description: Source code implementing ECDSA signature creation and verification functions, including internal utilities for scalar conversion, signature management, and self-test integration within the OpenSSL/Boringssl cryptography library.

methods.name: digest_to_scalar
methods.description: Converts a digest into a scalar suitable for ECDSA operations, handling truncation and reduction to fit the group order.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new ECDSA_SIG structure.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_free
methods.description: Frees an ECDSA_SIG structure and its components.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_get0_r
methods.description: Returns the r component of the signature.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_get0_s
methods.description: Returns the s component of the signature.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_get0
methods.description: Retrieves r and s components of the signature.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_set0
methods.description: Sets the r and s components of the signature.

methods.name: ecdsa_do_verify_no_self_test
methods.description: Performs ECDSA signature verification without self-test.

methods.name: ECDSA_do_verify
methods.description: Performs ECDSA signature verification with self-test.

methods.name: ecdsa_sign_impl
methods.description: Core implementation of ECDSA signing, computing r and s values.

methods.name: ecdsa_sign_with_nonce_for_known_answer_test
methods.description: Signs a digest with a specified nonce for testing purposes.

methods.name: ECDSA_sign_with_nonce_and_leak_private_key_for_testing
methods.description: Exported for testing, signs with nonce, leaks private key.

methods.name: ECDSA_do_sign
methods.description: Signs a digest, implementing the standard ECDSA sign process with additional hashing for entropy hardening.
